long_biography.plain_text:
After spending much of his early life in Argentina, Grandi qualified as an engineer at Politecnico di Milano. He later took over the direction of Osvaldo Rigamonti S.A. from his father Fernando. Away from business, he became a successful competitive sailor, steering Atrevido to victories across several races and seasons.

After moving to Lugano, Grandi began financing Terre des Hommes programmes. The death of his youngest son, Renato, became the impetus for a family foundation created in 2009. Grandi initially chaired it and later remained vice-president, supporting schools, medical care and water infrastructure for children and communities in Africa. He died on 25 October 2024, after which the organisation added his name to the foundation's own.
